import collections

names := "ABCDEFG"
edges := [
    (0, 1, 7), (0, 2, 3), (0, 3, 9), (1, 2, 2), (2, 4, 6), (1, 3, 3), (3, 4, 4), (3, 5, 5),
    (4, 5, 3), (4, 6, 8), (5, 6, 4),
]
graph := collections.weighted_adjacency_lists(7, edges, undirected = true)
distance := array(7, fill = -1)
predecessor := array(7, fill = -1)
ready := array(7, fill = false)
nat start := 0
distance[start] = 0
ready[start] = true
while true
    next := collections.argmin(distance, where = ready)
    match next
        none
            break
        nat selected
            ready[selected] = false
            for (vertex, weight) := graph[selected][]
                candidate := distance[selected] + weight
                if distance[vertex] == -1 or candidate < distance[vertex]
                    distance[vertex] = candidate
                    predecessor[vertex] = int(selected)
                    ready[vertex] = true
for: vertex < 7
    string[] path := []
    current := vertex
    while current != -1
        .path.push(names[current])
        current = predecessor[current]
    println("{names[vertex]}: distance={distance[vertex]} path={path[::-1].join("-")}")
